staff: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production sprite atlas for Cyber Kingdom, a side-scrolling pixel-art fantasy refuge powered by turquoise dragon crystals. Create exactly 24 COMPLETE FULL-BODY character sprites arranged in a strict 4-column by 6-row grid on a genuinely transparent background. Each row is ONE distinctive building attendant, all facing right in side / slight three-quarter view. Every column is a different restrained idle / occupational full-body pose of that same person, feet planted at an identical row baseline. Same costume and scale across all four columns, generous clear gutters, no cell borders, no labels, no shadows outside the sprite, no floor. Row 1: elderly hearth keeper with huge ivory beard, deep russet hooded cape, lantern held low, short brass prosthetic leg. Row 2: stocky female master mechanic, raised round goggles, leather apron, oversized articulated brass prosthetic forearm and small hammer, muscular silhouette. Row 3: elderly seed keeper, enormous broad straw hat, moss-green poncho, round seed basket, one tiny glowing mechanical hand. Row 4: lean huntmaster, long feathered raven hood, layered teal fur cloak and curved bow slung on back, inspecting an arrow. Row 5: dragon-crystal artificer, tall pointed indigo hood, circular brass calibration halo attached to backpack, crystalline prosthetic fingers adjusting a hovering SMALL turquoise core. Row 6: broad armored quartermaster, copper horned helmet, heavy burgundy tabard, distinct square pauldrons, resting a tower shield on the ground. Four poses per row should form a restrained readable cycle, like lantern checking, hammer adjusting, seed sorting, arrow checking, crystal tuning, shield checking. Clear differences of silhouette, headwear, body proportions and tools. Crisp high quality handcrafted pixel art, outlined clusters, weathered warm wood/brass and charcoal iron, selective cyan light. Characters intended to be about 52 native pixels high. No UI, no text, no weapons for keeper/mechanic/farmer/artificer except occupational tools, no scenery. Do not crop any hat, feet, tool or cape.
buildings: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: six reusable building sprites for the 2D side-scrolling pixel-art game Cyber Kingdom. Create ONE clean 2-column by 3-row sprite sheet of SIX different COMPLETE isolated buildings, generous empty gutters, genuinely transparent background. Front / slight side view at ground level, absolutely no isometric or overhead view, every complete structure rests on a horizontal baseline. No humans, no text, no labels, no sky or scenery. Same handmade fantasy refuge family: weathered wood, charcoal stone, brass pipes, small turquoise dragon-crystal technology, warm amber interiors, crisp pixel clusters. Each must be recognizable by silhouette when reduced to about 130–210 native pixels wide and 90–140 pixels high. Top-left: mechanic workshop with asymmetric tall copper chimney, exposed giant cogwheel, open repair bench, hammer/tool rack, low sloping wooden roof. Top-right: seedkeeper greenhouse with curved green glass dome, seed trays and woven baskets, two huge leaves used as awnings, compact terracotta base. Middle-left: huntmaster lodge, steep raven-wing-shaped dark timber roof with feathers, hanging curved bows and a leather quiver rack, no human trophies. Middle-right: quartermaster barracks, wide squat charcoal-stone shield-shaped entrance, copper horned crest, burgundy hanging banners without markings, armor stands. Bottom-left: prosthetic artificer station, open circular brass armillary arch with a restrained turquoise crystal at its center, intricate workbench, indigo triangular canopy; compact open-front kiosk. Bottom-right: remote outpost, tall narrow timber lookout on low stone feet with large lantern cage, travel packs, weatherproof hide awning, clearly distinct from the other five. A designed sprite sheet for actual game integration, not an illustration poster. All six fully visible, separated, ample padding, no ground shadows extending beyond each building, no cropped roofs or side props. High craft, consistent pixel-art density, useful negative space between forms.
trail_props: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production sprite sheet for a 2D side-scrolling pixel-art fantasy game, Cyber Kingdom. Exactly FOURTEEN isolated low roadside props, arranged in TWO columns and SEVEN clearly separated rows, strict grid, generous gutters, transparent background. Front-facing ground-level side-scroller view, not isometric. No characters, no text, no labels, no interface, no ground plane or cast shadow. All full silhouettes visible. Each prop will be reduced to roughly 70–100 pixels wide and 35–65 pixels tall, so make its silhouette simple and memorable, no giant architecture. LEFT column in each row is a small creature nest containing a subdued dragon-crystal reward. RIGHT column is an unguarded exploration find. Row 1 forest: thorny root den with gnawed green crystals / hollow mossy log with a travel satchel and small amber crystal. Row 2 desert: cracked sandstone burrow framed by scavenged rib-like metal / half-buried leather expedition bag with a torn ochre sail and cyan vial. Row 3 frost: low jagged ice shell with blue crystal core / squat frost-covered supply chest embedded in clear ice. Row 4 swamp: low tangled fungal nest with lime spores / two wide mushroom caps sheltering a tiny seed vessel and luminous crystals. Row 5 volcanic: broken black basalt egg-like shell with molten orange fissures / cooled slag bowl with three copper-red crystals. Row 6 storm ruins: small nest of bent copper cables and blue thorn crystals / fallen cylindrical charge casket with one turquoise coil and severed cable. Row 7 void: low curved obsidian rib cage around a faint violet crystal / small ancient weathered travel urn and a fragment of purple cloth. Keep left and right distinct, with silhouettes characteristic of their environments. Beautiful crisp pixel art, dark readable outlines, controlled light, no diffuse glow cloud outside objects. Never crop any shape. Empty areas must be alpha transparent.
